reserveReview.rationale: Observed 2026-10-10T23:34:41Z: the issuer's transparency page and bankCirculation/getAll API report 7,147,300.66 euros, entirely allocated to Lietuvos bankas via NexPay, but neither supplies an allocation as-of timestamp. The published daily-statement index's newest entry is dated 2025-12-12; its NexPay PDF covers 2025-12-11 and reports a 7,382,350.66 euro closing balance, not the live allocation amount. The site's generic promise to update each working day does not date these figures. The previously inferred 2026-09-18 composition date is therefore removed; current dated whole-book composition is unverified. This changes no reserve percentages and grants no financial assurance.

sources.label: STASIS Terms of Business, sections 3 and 8: separate safeguarded accounts, insolvency protection promise and prohibition on lending or other use

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The live page names NexPay UAB as the route to the Lithuanian Central Bank account. STSS's Terms of Business define Safeguarded Accounts as separate from its office accounts, promise protection at an EEA-authorised financial institution if STSS becomes insolvent, prohibit use of customer funds for any other purpose, and state that STSS cannot and will not lend them. These are contractual issuer commitments. The account agreement, statutory insolvency treatment and independent legal opinion remain unavailable, so structured bankruptcy remoteness is not established. The terms exclude deposit-guarantee and investor-compensation coverage.
